reason: I've been burned by 'agencies' that took a fee and vanished, and a beta app with a small team asking me to connect my Instagram feels like the same story with a nicer website. I might poke at the free month, but I'm not paying for a pass until I see real paid leads, not cafés offering free dosa.
objection: Who are these local businesses actually? Most cafés here pay in food, not money, and I already get collab leads free in my WhatsApp groups, so why would I pay ₹499 for more barter offers from an app I can't verify?
would_change_my_mind: Two or three creators from my WhatsApp groups telling me they got actual cash payments, on time, through a brand they found on Mitra.
